testcase.name: Scenario: Show hover feedback for a sketch curve offered to a selection tool: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-SGy6Pe/checkout/features/sketch/viewport-entity-interaction/viewport-entity-interaction.feature:9:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show hover feedback for a sketch curve offered to a selection tool ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying an editable sketch ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given the sketch contains a curve and a sketch tool is requesting a curve selection ✔ When the user hovers over a candidate curve segment ✔ Then the candidate segment receives pointer highlight feedback before it is selected

testcase.name: Scenario: Select a sketch entity in the ready state: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-SGy6Pe/checkout/features/sketch/viewport-entity-interaction/viewport-entity-interaction.feature:29:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Select a sketch entity in the ready state ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying an editable sketch ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given an editable sketch contains an unselected line and the sketch is ready for input ✔ When the user clicks the line away from its endpoints and constraint glyphs ✔ Then the line becomes the selected sketch entity ✔ And the viewport displays a distinct selected state ✔ When the user clicks empty sketch space ✔ Then the line is no longer selected

testcase.name: Scenario: Resolve a pick where sketch entities overlap: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-SGy6Pe/checkout/features/sketch/viewport-entity-interaction/viewport-entity-interaction.feature:54:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Resolve a pick where sketch entities overlap ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying an editable sketch ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given an editable sketch contains a curve and a selectable point at the same screen location ✔ When the user clicks the overlapping location ✔ Then the MCAD Software identifies the picked entity type ✔ And any available pick-choice control identifies the alternatives

testcase.name: Scenario: Create geometry through a pointer-driven sketch tool: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-SGy6Pe/checkout/features/sketch/viewport-entity-interaction/viewport-entity-interaction.feature:61:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create geometry through a pointer-driven sketch tool ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying an editable sketch ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a sketch geometry tool is active and requesting viewport input ✔ When the user selects the positions required by that tool ✔ Then accepted geometry appears in the sketch ✔ And the tool advances to its next input or returns to Ready ✔ When the user presses Escape while a later placement preview is pending ✔ Then the pending preview is removed ✔ And previously accepted geometry remains in the sketch

testcase.name: Scenario: Modify geometry with a tool that previews before commitment: tmp/oblikovati-bdd-SGy6Pe/checkout/features/sketch/viewport-entity-interaction/viewport-entity-interaction.feature:71:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Modify geometry with a tool that previews before commitment ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying an editable sketch ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a sketch modification tool is requesting existing geometry ✔ And the tool has not committed its result ✔ When the user picks the required sketch entities ✔ Then the tool displays a pending preview of the modification ✔ When the user cancels before committing the result ✔ Then the pending preview is removed ✔ And the original sketch geometry remains unchanged
